//: 1040 flops of register file and 64-byte memory make nets with hundreds of loads. repair_design buffered them with dly* delay cells (~1.7ns each), which put ~20ns of pure delay on the critical path; buf_1 drove long nets past the 3ns ss slew limit. With both excluded, a 45% density and 300um wire caps for repair, and 30% slew/cap margins after global routing (35% overflows routing), post-route slew stays inside the limit at every ss corner. CTS clusters of 10 sinks with 250um wires keep the clock tree's own slew down.
